extracted.summary: The Post‑Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child is a UGC scheme for girl students who are the only girl child in their family, providing financial support for up to two years of a first‑year master’s course.
extracted.genders_quote: Applicants must be a girl student up to 30 years of age at the time of admission.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must have taken admission to a regular full-time first-year master's degree course in any designated university or a post-graduate college.
extracted.max_age_quote: Applicants must be a girl student up to 30 years of age at the time of admission.
